question: Which basic neural architecture perform best by itself?
title: Neural Architectures for Fine-Grained Propaganda Detection in News
answer_rationale: The documents discuss various neural architectures (CNN, LSTM-CRF, BERT) and their performance in combination with features and ensemble methods, but none explicitly state which single architecture performs best by itself without any augmentation or combination. Performance comparisons are often made in ensembles or with additional features, making it impossible to definitively conclude which basic architecture performs best alone.
